# FG-CI-0026

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 403 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`ci-pipelines`](../../ops/runbooks/ci-pipelines.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_schedule_whose_owner_lost_the_right_starts_nothing` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 定期実行の持ち主がパイプラインを実行できなくなったため、定期実行は動きませんでした。メンテナーが定期実行を開いて保存し直してください。
- en: The scheduled pipeline did not run because its owner may no longer run pipelines. A Maintainer should open the schedule and save it again.
- id: Pipeline terjadwal tidak berjalan karena pemiliknya tidak lagi boleh menjalankan pipeline. Seorang Maintainer perlu membuka jadwal dan menyimpannya lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C12 (ADR-0029 Amendment 2026-11-13): a pipeline schedule runs with the rights of its owner — the person who last saved it. At each due time the worker (job `ci.schedule_fire`) decides `PipelineCreate` for the owner as a signed-in person, on the project and the account as they are then, in the same transaction that would write the pipeline. The decision refused: the owner was disabled, left the project, was lowered below Developer, or the project is being deleted. No pipeline was started; the schedule stays active and is refused the same way at every due time until someone takes it over. A schedule never runs with more rights than its owner has now, and never with secrets (a scheduled pipeline is never `protected`).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

One warn log line `forge.ci.schedule_refused` with `error_code`, `request_id`, `schedule_id`, `project_id`, `owner_id` and `cause_code` (the refusal: FG-AUTH-0003 Forbidden, FG-AUTH-0004 AccountDisabled, FG-REPO-0005 NotFound, FG-REPO-0006 PendingDeletion) plus its `reason` / `required_role`. The schedule row records it: SELECT id, owner_id, last_run_at, last_outcome, last_error_code FROM forge.ci_pipeline_schedules WHERE id = <schedule_id>; (`last_outcome = 'refused'`). The project's schedules page shows the same line.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook ci-pipelines (Schedules): a Maintainer opens the schedule and saves it (they become its owner), or deletes it if it is no longer wanted. Restoring the old owner's role also lets it run again.
